title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
title_zh: DOGS：面向提示驱动徽标生成的设计空间采样

paragraphs.en: DOGS是一种为提示驱动的标志生成设计空间采样方法，通过结构化设计空间优化提示，减少商标侵权风险。 Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.
paragraphs.zh: DOGS 是一种为提示驱动的标志生成设计空间采样方法，通过结构化设计空间优化提示，减少商标侵权风险。文本到图像（T2I）生成的提示优化几乎完全以文本重写的方式实现，即将简短的用户说明扩展为模型更偏好的更长令牌序列。 我们认为，这种语言空间的表述方式并不适合结构化视觉设计任务（如标志创作），因为单行说明无法明确大多数设计决策。 这些决策依赖于线性序列无法编码的关系性先验知识，并留下一个不受控制的通道，可能导致受保护标志被复制。 因此，我们将标志提示重构为在结构化设计空间内进行采样，并将这一理念具体化为 DOGS（基于原创性感知 GFlowNet 采样器的设计空间提示方法）。 我们从大量真实世界标志语料库中挖掘出一种带类型标注的图结构设计语法，其边记录了经验性的共现关系。 随后，GFlowNet 采样器会生成设计图，其概率与终端奖励成正比，该奖励综合了可识别性、美学性和相对于语料库的原创性。 每个槽位仅从封闭的设计层级词汇表中抽取元素，任何可能引发侵权或有害的令牌在解析过程中都会被移除。 原创性奖励还会对与现有标志的相似性进行惩罚，从而在方法构建中直接融入了侵权规避机制。 在两种开源渲染器和九种基线方法对比中，DOGS 生成的标志更具可识别性和美学价值，多样性显著提升，且商标侵权风险远低于其他方法。
